request: How do I check if your internet service is available in my area?
reply: Enter your full address or estate name in our coverage checker tool. It shows real-time availability for Ikeja, Yaba, Iyana-Ipaja, Ogba, Aboru, Alakuko, and many other areas. If your location isn't listed yet, join the waitlist — we expand weekly!

request: Which parts of Lagos do you currently cover?
reply: We actively serve key zones including Iyana-Ipaja, and several estates in Ogba, Aboru, and parts of the Mainland. New estates are added monthly — check the interactive map or coverage tool for your exact street/estate.

request: Do you cover my estate/gated community?
reply: Many estates require management approval or right-of-way access. If your estate isn't on our coverage list yet, submit your estate name via the form below. We're actively partnering with estate managements across Lagos — approval usually takes 2-6 weeks.

request: What if my street or area is not yet covered?
reply: Join our waitlist! We prioritize expansion based on demand. Areas with 15+ sign-ups move much faster. You can also refer neighbors — we offer referral credits when groups in the same area sign up together.

request: How long does it take to expand coverage to a new area or estate?
reply: Once we receive enough interest (usually 10-20 households/businesses), survey & planning takes 2-4 weeks, trenching/fiber deployment 4-10 weeks (depending on estate approvals and permissions). Average time from waitlist to first activations: 2-4 months in high-demand Lagos zones.

request: Is your coverage affected by power outages in Lagos?
reply: Our core network uses power backups (inverters + generators) at base stations and major nodes. However, the final connection to your home depends on your building's power situation. We recommend customers use UPS/inverters for the router — most customers maintain connectivity during short outages.

request: Do you offer service in multi-storey buildings or high-rises?
reply: Yes — we install in many apartments, penthouses, and office buildings in Lagos. Coverage depends on line-of-sight (for wireless) or fiber riser access (for FTTH). Our team conducts a free site survey to confirm signal strength or fiber feasibility.

request: What kind of Wi-Fi coverage can I expect inside my home/house?
reply: Our standard router covers ~1,500-2,000 sq ft in open spaces. Thick walls, multiple floors, or metal structures can reduce range. We offer free signal assessment during installation and optional mesh Wi-Fi extenders for whole-home coverage (very popular in duplexes and large compounds).

request: Can I get service if I live near your covered area but not directly inside it?
reply: Possibly — we sometimes extend coverage 200-500 meters beyond current zones during expansions. Submit your address for a free feasibility check. We'll let you know if we can reach your location without major extra infrastructure.

request: Do you cover commercial areas, small offices, or shops?
reply: Yes — we serve SMEs, co-working spaces, cafes, clinics, and small offices in covered zones. Business plans offer higher upload speeds and static IPs where needed. Contact our business team for a site survey.

request: How accurate is your coverage map / checker tool?
reply: The map is updated weekly based on active infrastructure. It shows “green = service available now”, “yellow = coming soon / waitlist open”, “gray = not yet planned”. Final confirmation always comes after a free site survey (we confirm signal or fiber reach).

request: What happens if coverage changes or gets better in my area after I sign up?
reply: We continuously upgrade — many customers get free speed upgrades when we bring fiber closer or improve the network. You keep your plan price (no mid-contract increases).

request: Do I need approval from my estate, landlord, or NEPA before installation?
reply: In most estates — yes (written permission from management). In rented apartments — landlord consent is usually required. Our team helps coordinate approvals and provides official letters. No trenching happens without permission.

request: Is there any cost if my area is not covered yet but I join the waitlist?
reply: No — joining the waitlist is 100% free and non-binding. You only pay when service is available and you decide to proceed with installation.
